title: Sagan's NSA contractor green badge

tellings.quote: he had a contractor green badge with a picture on it you you don't get that if you're casual

plain: Bob Maguire, described as a contractor who worked for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the well-known scientist Carl Sagan carried a green contractor badge with his photo for the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications. Maguire says you do not get a badge like that if your connection is casual, which would mean Sagan worked closely with the agency.
